title: Mihrimah Sultan Mosque, Edirnekapı
scope: The restored Edirnekapı Mihrimah Sultan Mosque on the sixth hill, including its roof and single minaret, seven-bay marble porch, windowed sides, open court with the fountain, and the enclosing historic madrasa ranges.
limitations: The surviving restored silhouette uses the documented single slender minaret. Its height, rear roof lines, lead roofing tones, window lattices and courtyard paving are approximations derived from the published references.
The model follows the named mosque compound. The distinct hammam, historic city wall, interiors and surrounding independent buildings are outside its footprint.
